Networked Gas Consumption 2024 release and tables

description: Networked Gas Consumption is an annual statistical release of the Central Statistics Office (CSO) of Ireland on gas used through the gas network by power plants, non-residential meters and residential meters. The 2024 edition was released on 30 October 2025 by the CSO Climate and Energy Division; it reports 53,856 GWh consumed in 2024, of which 65% by power plants, 24% by non-residential and 11% by residential meters, with a median household consumption of 7,771 kWh. Tables give consumption by sector for 2015 to 2024, by quarter for each sector, by county for residential and non-residential users, and by Dublin postal district, including meter counts and median household consumption. Earlier editions, such as the 2019 release, are also online, and third parties have converted the Dublin district tables to Parquet and GeoJSON on Zenodo. Coverage is Ireland's gas network areas. Tables are Excel files and web pages, accessible and downloadable from the CSO website at no cost; CSO statistics are licensed under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: data are annual and aggregated, and the 2019 edition warns about COVID-19 effects on quality. Simulation uses are gas demand and security of supply modelling, seasonal peak analysis and gas-to-power studies for Ireland. Related records: data-enagad-european-natural-gas-demand gives daily national gas demand for Europe.
